timeline.note: Kane was a secret special agent at the time of his apparent death. He only became Agent Zero after his apparent death (to be expanded).

relationships.name: Evelyn Cross
relationships.believes: Kane was an Army sergeant killed in action on a mission.
relationships.notes: Kane helped rescue her on an earlier mission (details undisclosed). They fell for each other immediately and were engaged about 2 months after meeting. She told him she was pregnant about 3 months in, one week before his final mission.

relationships.name: Jenny
relationships.believes: Her father, if Kane, was an Army sergeant killed in action.
relationships.notes: Unborn when Kane 'died'. He has never met her. He learned of her existence later and is not sure he is her father, but longs to be.

psychology.external_want: Expose and dismantle the unnamed shadow network behind Operation Blackstar.
psychology.internal_need: Overcome weaponized paranoia and learn when to place trust in an ally again.
psychology.fatal_flaw: Extreme distrust; isolates himself and assumes every handler or friend is running an angle.

voice.cadence: Measured, calm, economical; grows quieter as danger escalates.
sample_lines: If I'm dead, what exactly am I supposed to be?

visual.appearance_summary: British male, early 40s, lean athletic build, understated tailored suits or unbranded matte tactical gear.
visual.image_prompt_seed: British man in his early 40s, sharp observant eyes, weathered calm expression, dark tailored minimalist suit, moody cinematic lighting, realistic espionage thriller aesthetic

skills_and_abilities: Trace Analysis (highlights environmental clues, footsteps, digital footprints, and micro-expressions)
Ghost Disguise (blends into diplomatic, corporate, or criminal environments)
Tactical De-escalation (avoids combat by exploiting patrol patterns and psychology)

dialogue_triggers.on_greet: You shouldn't know I'm here. Let's make this quick.
dialogue_triggers.on_threatened: You're making a mistake. And you're leaving far too much evidence behind.
dialogue_triggers.on_idle: Everybody leaves a trace. You just have to wait long enough for them to get careless.
